sn45.3:1.2: atha kho āyasmā sārīputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sārīputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn45.3:1.3: sakalamidaṃ bhante brahmacariyaṃ yadidaṃ kalyāṇamittatā kalyāṇasahāyatā kalyāṇasampavaṅkatāti.
sn45.3:2.2: sakalamidaṃ sārīputta brahmacariyaṃ yadidaṃ kalyāṇamittatā kalyāṇasahāyatā kalyāṇasampavaṅkatā.
sn45.3:2.3: kalyāṇamittassetaṃ sārīputta bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ kalyāṇasahāyassa kalyāṇasampavaṅkassa ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvessati ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarissatīti.
sn45.3:2.4: kathañca sārīputta bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāveti ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaroti.
sn45.3:3.1: idha sārīputta bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ. pe. sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossagga pariṇāmiṃ.
sn45.3:3.2: evaṃ kho sārīputta bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāveti ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaroti.
sn45.3:4.1: tadimināpetaṃ sārīputta pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā sakalamidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ yadidaṃ kalyāṇamittatā kalyāṇasahāyatā kalyāṇasampavaṅkatāti.
sn45.3:4.2: mamañhi sārīputta kalyāṇamittaṃ āgamma jātidhammā sattā jātiyā parimuccanti jarādhammā sattā jarāya parimuccanti maraṇadhammā sattā maraṇena parimuccanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsadhammā sattā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassu pāyāsehi parimuccanti.
sn45.3:4.3: iminā kho etaṃ sārīputta pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā sakalamidaṃ brahmacariyaṃ yadidaṃ kalyāṇamittatā kalyāṇa sahāyatā kalyāṇasampavaṅkatāti.
